notablePrerequisites: Evernight Shade has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Evernight Shade using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 until Evernight Shade has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Evernight Shade abilities dealing 1 damage to Evernight Shade, and any remaining damage to any target(s).
Evernight Shade dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Evernight Shade's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
